messages.content: Read only factual statements in the current facts and question and return every coherent supported view. Identify the queried person and year. Represent marriage in its source-native form: ongoing_since for wording that the marriage has been in force since a date; onset_only when only commencement is supported; closed_interval only when both endpoints are explicitly supported. Never invent an end date. Represent divorce or separate-maintenance decrees as ongoing_from only when text or native case semantics supports continuing status, effective_only when only a dated decree is supported, and closed_interval when both endpoints are supported. Extract actual separate/not-separate return facts. Under the shared native interpretation, an expressly allowed itemized deduction amount is an itemized=true event; generic income or merely possible eligibility is not. Use [] only for a resolved finite channel with no event and null for unread or failed extraction. Include nonempty verbatim current facts/question witnesses in every view. Do not decide marital status under the statute, section applicability, eligibility, entailment, contradiction, or a final answer.
